description:
Following the completion of 
LAMOS Phase 1
, which primarily established the foundational 
User Access Management (UAM)
 capabilities, 
Phase 2
 will focus on enabling the end-to-end SME loan origination and credit approval process within LAMOS.
The scope will cover the journey from 
loan application submission by the Account Officer (AO)
, including customer, facility, and 
collateral information
, followed by 
Team Leader (TL) review
, 
Credit Analysis by the Credit Analyst (CA)
, and ultimately 
Credit Committee approval
. Collateral-related capabilities, which were previously planned under a separate phase, will be incorporated into Phase 2 to ensure that collateral information is available as an integral part of the credit assessment and approval process.
In parallel, Phase 2 must consider the impact and alignment with 
Project Falcon
, a credit transformation initiative supported by McKinsey, particularly across its key components: 
SmartCA
, 
Bank Statement Analyzer (BSA)
, and 
Credit Underwriting Engine (CUE)
. These capabilities may introduce changes to the credit analysis process, data requirements, assessment methodology, underwriting rules, and user responsibilities between AO and CA. Therefore, LAMOS Phase 2 needs to accommodate the relevant Falcon requirements while maintaining a seamless and controlled origination workflow from AO submission through Credit Committee decision.
Processes occurring after credit approval—including 
AO Offering Letter (AO OL)
, 
AO Credit Agreement / Perjanjian Kredit (AO PK)
, fulfillment of 
Pre-Disbursement requirements
, and subsequent loan booking and disbursement activities—will be addressed in the 
following phases
 of LAMOS implementation.
